# Alan Pruitt

> Personal portfolio, research hub, and sovereign Curriculum-as-Code (CaC) repository of Alan Pruitt.

## Essays

- [Essay 01: Shifting from AI Fear to Strategic Assessment Design](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/01-ai-assessment-design.html): How Curriculum-as-Code paradigms transform educators from passive task checkers into problem architects by auditing cognitive processes rather than static answers.
- [Essay 02: Curriculum-as-Code: Treating Educational Content Like Software Development](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/02-curriculum-as-code.html): Why proprietary LMS platforms fail modern compliance and how Git version control, Markdown SSoT, and CI/CD validation redefine instructional engineering.
- [Essay 03: Air-Gapped & Sovereign AI: Local Intelligence in High-Compliance Environments](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/03-air-gapped-sovereign-ai.html): Why sovereign, air-gapped Gemma models and edge-native AI infrastructure outperform public cloud APIs for privacy-critical academic and institutional workloads.
- [Essay 04: Architecting Born-Accessible Higher Ed: ADA Title II & Curriculum-as-Code](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/04-ada-title-ii-accessibility.html): How Curriculum-as-Code paradigms solve systemic ADA Title II and Section 508 compliance issues by embedding automated WCAG 2.1 AA validation into plain-text instructional pipelines.
- [Essay 05: Instructional Engineering: Transforming Curriculum into Source Code](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/05-instructional-engineering.html): How applying continuous integration, modular component design, and plain-text single sources of truth redefines modern instructional architecture.
- [Essay 06: Practical AI in Canvas: Supporting Course Design & Engagement](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/06-canvas-ai-course-design.html): Practical strategies, native Canvas capabilities, and responsible implementation frameworks for leveraging AI inside higher education LMS environments.
- [Essay 07: Continuous Integration for Pedagogy: Automated Unit Tests](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/07-continuous-integration-pedagogy.html): How applying CI pipeline linting, AST mapping, and automated prerequisite graph validation guarantees instructional integrity before code hits production.
- [Essay 08: Sovereign Localization: Multi-Lingual & Dialect Pipelines](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/08-bilingual-localization-pipelines.html): Architecting Git-driven i18n/l10n pipelines for higher education that maintain strict 1:1 pedagogical parity across English and Spanish course shells without third-party data egress.
- [Essay 09: Immutable Learning Analytics & Privacy-First Telemetry](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/09-immutable-learning-analytics.html): Evolving learning analytics from passive LMS surveillance to sovereign, privacy-first event telemetry and client-side anonymous performance data.
- [Essay 10: The AI Safety Auditor Pattern in Applied Kinesiology](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/10-ai-safety-auditor-pattern.html): Moving beyond passive AI quiz masters to deterministic clinical safety auditors in health science education using structured delimiter protocols.
- [Essay 11: The Two-Part Scaffold Framework](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/11-two-part-scaffold-framework.html): Designing hybrid kinesiology laboratory modules that combine digital AI simulation gating with onsite research-grade cycle ergometry and tactile physiological testing.
- [Essay 12: The Mission Loop Architecture](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/12-mission-loop-architecture.html): Structuring deterministic health science problem-solving pipelines that enforce pattern identification, rule citation, and audited intervention.
- [Essay 13: The Vibe-Coding Paradigm](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/13-vibe-coding-paradigm.html): How domain expertise and AI-driven full-stack execution collapse the distance between pedagogical vision and live production applications.
- [Essay 14: The Guided Learning Trifecta](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/14-guided-learning-trifecta.html): Combining Google's Guided Learning principles with Curriculum-as-Code to create a three-tier execution pipeline for high-stakes health science education.
- [Essay 15: Algorithmic Pedagogy & Continuous Integration](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/15-algorithmic-pedagogy-ci.html): When traditional course design meets institutional scaling, it almost always encounters a friction point: version decay. Syllabi drift out of alignment with lab rubrics, external links break, accreditation standards shift, and manual updates introduce silent regressions into LMS course shells.
- [Essay 16: Canvas LMS 3-Track Self-Guided AI Branch and Bilingual Scaffolding](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/16-canvas-lms-3-track-ai-branch.html): The modern higher education landscape—particularly within kinesiology, exercise science, and community health—demands an instructional framework that bridges theoretical knowledge with real-world professional practice. Standard learning management system (LMS) discussion forums frequently fail to achieve this, falling into repetitive "echo chambers" where students analyze identical prompts and reply with superficial agreement.
- [Essay 17: Engineering Resilience: Resolving False-Positive Contrast Errors and Array Parsing Script Failures via Curriculum-as-Code](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/17-resolving-array-parsing-script-failures.html): How automated accessibility checkers fail under WYSIWYG visual-editor DOM pollution and how Curriculum-as-Code resolves array parsing failures at the source.
- [Essay 18: The Illusion of the Feed: Upstream SSoT and Feed Link Rot Governance](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/18-the-illusion-of-the-feed.html): How relying on dynamic external feeds inside an LMS introduces link rot vulnerabilities, and how upstream SSoT configuration control resolves accessibility issues at the source.
- [Essay 19: The Hybrid Ergometer Scaffold: Synchronizing AI Simulation with Lab Precision](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/19-hybrid-ergometer-scaffold.html): How EXW245 decouples cognitive pre-flight mathematical verification from physical laboratory execution using a two-part scaffold pairing Gemini AI simulation sandboxes with Lode Corival research-grade cycle ergometers.
- [Essay 20: Deterministic Clinical Guardrails: Preventing Hallucination Drift](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/20-deterministic-clinical-guardrails.html): How EXW265 deploys deterministic prompt guardrails, strict delimiter encapsulation, and the federal PAGA 2018 Single Source of Truth to eliminate dangerous AI hallucination drift in exercise prescriptions for chronic conditions.
- [Essay 21: Evidence-Based Nutrition vs. The Feed: Upstream SSoT Governance](https://alanpruitt.com/articles/21-evidence-based-nutrition-vs-feed.html): How EXW150 uses Curriculum-as-Code, the Mission Loop framework, and federal SSoT standards to insulate community college students from social media fad diets, predatory supplement claims, and unanchored AI nutrition advice.
